children: New York, New York, October 6th, 2026, Chainwire
Earn Stocks turns supported Coinbase Tokenized Stocks into productive collateral through transparent, rule-based strategies automated by SuperformOS.

Superform today announced the activation of Earn Stocks on Base, powered by Aave. The rollout begins with superNVDA, with additional Mag 7 SuperStocks to follow: superTSLA, superMSFT, superMETA, superAAPL, superAMZN, and superGOOGL.

Tokenization brought familiar assets onchain. It did not make those assets productive. SuperStocks is Superform’s family of products built on supported tokenized equities, and Earn Stocks is the strategy layer that puts the assets inside those products to work through defined, transparent mandates.

Each SuperStock posts a supported Coinbase Tokenized Stock as collateral in Aave V4’s Equities Hub on Base and borrows USDC. The strategy programmatically deploys the borrowed USDC through venues permitted by its mandate when expected returns clear borrowing and execution costs, liquidity requirements, and a risk buffer.
“Tokenization is not the end product. The bigger opportunity is turning onchain assets into financial products without passing the complexity of collateral, credit, and execution to the user,” said
Vikram Arun, Co-Founder and CEO of Superform
. “SuperformOS is the infrastructure that makes that possible, and Earn Stocks shows it in action.”
There is clear demand for equities to do more onchain. During pre-deposit, superNVDA attracted nearly 10% of all NVDAc issued on Base.
SuperformOS automates rule-based LTV management, debt, accounting, monitoring, repayment, redemption, and unwind across both legs of the strategy.

"Tokenized stocks have significant potential as onchain collateral, and Aave V4 on Base was built to serve that use case, allowing eligible users outside the U.S. to borrow USDC against supported Coinbase Tokenized Stocks. SuperStocks extends that credit primitive with an automated onchain Earn strategy, a unique product we expect to grow alongside tokenized stocks on Aave V4," said
Luigi D'Onorio DeMeo, Chief Strategy and Business Officer at Aave Labs
"Coinbase Tokenized Stocks passed $1.5B in onchain volume on Base in 6 weeks. That tells you the demand is there," said
Antonio García Martínez, Head of Growth, Base
. "The bigger question is what a stock can do once it's onchain: serve as collateral, back a loan, earn. Superform is one of the first to put a real answer in front of users."
Earn Stocks is initially available to eligible users through superNVDA. Additional SuperStocks will be activated in phases.
To learn more about Superform and SuperStocks, users can visit superform.xyz. Product availability varies by jurisdiction.
About Superform

Superform is the neobank for global markets. Buy U.S. stocks, earn on USD, trade crypto, and send money without restrictions. Under the hood, SuperformOS connects financial products so users can move between investing, earning, and trading in fewer steps and earn more money, safely.
